mapper.select: SELECT enabled FROM tier_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tier_settings SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, color, min_visits, bonus_stamps FROM loyalty_tiers ORDER BY min_visits
SELECT id, name, color, min_visits, bonus_stamps FROM loyalty_tiers WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty_tiers (id, name, color, min_visits, bonus_stamps, created_at, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, CAST(#{name} AS jsonb), #{color}, #{minVisits}, #{bonusStamps}, #{now}, #{now}, #{staffId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM loyalty_tiers t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.tier_id = t.id)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loyalty_tiers WHERE min_visits = #{minVisits} AND (CAST(#{exceptId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR id <> #{exceptId}))
SELECT count(*) FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND source = 'NFC_TAP' AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, count(s.id) AS visits FROM customers c LEFT JOIN stamps s ON s.customer_id = c.id AND s.source = 'NFC_TAP' AND s.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.id
mapper.select: SELECT tier_id, count(*) AS customers FROM ( SELECT (SELECT t.id FROM loyalty_tiers t WHERE t.min_visits <= v.visits ORDER BY t.min_visits DESC LIMIT 1) AS tier_id FROM () v ) x WHERE tier_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tier_id
SELECT count(*) FROM () v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loyalty_tiers t WHERE t.min_visits <= v.visits)
